title: Deeper/broader ACIS peer execution-safety and lineage refresh
mode: primary-source web research and read-only local plan review
scope: Recheck the open-source SAT/SAB parser and consumer routes already considered for semantic qualification
Audit external-payload execution safety before any optional parser/kernel run
Refresh FreeCAD importer and DWG converter boundaries
Separate open-source OCCT core from commercial ACIS exchange components
Confirm candidate parser lineage and keep independent evidence claims bounded

method.kind: Read current public primary project documentation/source and compare against existing plan owners
method.limitations: Repository pages are mutable unless linked to immutable commits. This review confirms source-level route and risk observations only; it does not establish runtime reachability of every InventorLoader Law expression, validity of a particular SAT/SAB payload, native FreeCAD behavior, or an independent kernel result.

findings.topic: InventorLoader ACIS Law evaluation is an execution-safety gate
findings.observed: Current Acis.py defines Law.evaluate() as eval(self.eq) after rewriting caret exponent syntax; the viewed call does not provide a restricted globals/locals mapping. importerSAT.py resolves ACIS bodies and constructs FreeCAD Part geometry. The source also contains separate text and binary reader entry points. This establishes a source-level risk in the candidate route, not a libdxfrw defect and not proof every input reaches evaluation.
doesNotEstablish: that every imported SAT/SAB file can trigger Law.evaluate
that an ACIS expression in a specific valid producer file is malicious or executable
a safe parser or sandboxed runtime result
DWG AcDs section extraction or entity-to-SAB owner closure
a kernel lineage independent of FreeCAD/Open CASCADE
findings.planUse: Before any optional payload run, pin the exact source revision, audit law-bearing reachability, and prove the chosen generated profile cannot reach eval or use a separately reviewed safe evaluator. Run only isolated, locally authored controls without network and with time/memory/output limits. Otherwise mark NOT_RUN_UNSAFE_ROUTE.

findings.topic: FreeCAD's stock DXF importer and DWG wrapper are separate limited routes
findings.observed: Current FreeCAD documentation lists distinct C++ and legacy importer capability sets, says stock DXF import cannot read the embedded ACIS SAT blob, and describes DWG conversion through an external converter followed by DXF import.
findings.planUse: Keep platform, converter, importer backend, and entity-family results separate. Do not use a successful common-2D or 3DFACE import as ACIS/AcDs semantic evidence.

findings.topic: OCCT ACIS exchange is not part of the open-source core
findings.observed: The official OCCT-Components preview lists ACIS SAT/SAB import-export as an extension and directs readers to purchase full components. The preview is not the exchange implementation.
findings.planUse: Do not classify stock OCCT or FreeCAD as an ACIS parser. A licensed component is an optional, separately authorized route, not an open-source peer or independent-kernel result.

findings.topic: ACIS and DWG/DXF peer routes remain profile and lineage bounded
findings.observed: CADMPEG's documented SAT/SAB route is a bare-stream parser/transfer lane with selected profiles, not DWG or AcDs extraction. GitHub identifies compscientific/cadcodec as a fork of HakanSeven12/opencadcodec, itself a fork of ACadRust. InventorLoader's repository LICENSE contains GPL-2.0 text; the FreeCAD add-on catalog registration does not pin a source revision or release artifact, so license and source provenance remain pin-time checks.
findings.planUse: Reuse current S8/PAR-07 optional evidence intake. No repository name, feature table, generated blob, same-lineage readback, or shared FreeCAD/OCCT kernel promotes support.

nextActions: Continue the local implementation queue without installing or running a new peer.
Use InventorLoader only after exact-source safety preflight; isolate any run from untrusted files and networking.
Bind raw payload bytes to the originating entity/AcDs owner before comparing parser or geometry outputs.
Keep FreeCAD C++/legacy importer, platform, converter, and ACIS family outcomes separate.
Do not treat OCCT commercial components as open-source peers or ACadRust forks as independent parsers.
